articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expected to be ousted
articles.description: After a second extramarital affair was uncovered, Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang. Details of when and who might replace him aren't available. Nvidia's CEO could be ousted Even as Apple faces increased scrutiny around its approach to AI, there are real problems brewing in the outer AI industry. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with someone accused of being a Chinese spy. According to a report from the Wall Street Journal, a second extramarital affair coming to light Wednesday has forced the board to make a move. Huang could be ousted, though who might take over and the plan after are in question. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums
